: 
THE CRY OF SPIRITS When a man cries, he sheds *tears. But when spirits cry, what they shed is **burdens*. Spirits don't shed tears. When you see a spirit in a *vision weeping, with tears flowing from its eyelids, it is a visionary expression of the **outflow of the burdens vibrating within the walls of its heart*. This is part of the technology behind the emotional expressions of spirits—whether *Godly spirits or evil spirits*. Just as God releases burdens, Satan and demons can also release burdens into the hearts of men. In the realm of the spirit, burdens are *pains beyond the healing capacity of spirits. It takes **MEN* to heal the burdens of spirits. Man is typically the *channel of expression* through which spirits carry out their operations bodily. This is why many prophets say they saw God *crying. It is not necessarily about the physical tears they saw in the vision. The tears are a **visionary expression of the pain and burden in the heart of the Father*. The character of visions is such that spiritual realities are communicated to men through expressions they can comprehend. Spiritual messages are passed to mortals according to the *civilizations, languages, symbols, and realities that govern their sphere*. Therefore, many of the things we see in the spirit are *not necessarily as they literally appear*. This is why *discernment and interpretation are so pertinent*. You must learn to look beyond the imagery of a vision and discern the spiritual reality being communicated through it. Now, One of the major reasons believers become *lazy and irresponsible* is the absence of burden. A man without burden will struggle to carry responsibility. When there is no burden, there is no urgency. When there is no urgency, there is sacrifice. And when there is sacrifice, responsibility becomes a burden instead of a calling. *Burden is what gives responsibility weight.* There are things you will never do consistently until God places a burden for them in your heart. There are people you may never intercede for until their pain becomes a burden within you. There are territories you will never contend for until you carry their burden. There are assignments you will never pursue with seriousness until their burden begins to vibrate within the chambers of your spirit. Therefore, one of the things God does in the life of a man is to *deposit burdens*. The burden produces prayer. The burden produces sacrifice. The burden produces responsibility. The burden produces persistence. The burden turns revelation into action. *If you want to understand the seriousness of a man's assignment, look at the burden he carries for it.* A man may have knowledge without burden. He may have revelation without burden. He may even have an encounter without burden. But when burden is absent, *responsibility will eventually become optional*. This is why we must not only seek revelations from God; we must also seek the *burdens of God*. For sometimes, what God wants to give a man is not merely information about what He is doing, it is a *burden to become an instrument through which what He desires can be accomplished*. *When God gives you a burden, He is inviting you into responsibility.*
